room.label: U.S. adults
room.note: Only firm answers counted: 84% have always believed the world is round and 2% always flat. The two “more recently skeptical” groups (5% who always thought it round, 2% who always thought it flat) and 7% other or not sure are shown as unsure.
room.questionWording: Do you believe that the world is round or flat? (I have always believed the world is round / I always thought the world is round, but more recently I am skeptical / I always thought the world is flat, but more recently I am skeptical / I have always believed the world is flat / Other, not sure)

truthSource.label: NASA, Earth images
truthSource.oneLine: Spacecraft photography, circumnavigation and the physics of gravity all show the Earth is an oblate sphere.

lesson.tip: Confidence is not evidence. Ask whether the claim survives tests anyone can run, like ships disappearing hull-first over the horizon.
